ei.title: How Physical Touch Inhibits Plant Growth
ei.subject: 6월_2026 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: How Physical Touch Inhibits Plant Growth

fullPassage: The genomics revolution made it possible to see just how impactful touch is to plants on a deeper level. Peering at the genes of Arabidopsis thaliana, a weedy plant in the mustard family and the lab rat of the plant biology world, researchers saw that touch quietly triggered such a dramatic response in their hormones and gene expression that it could substantially inhibit their growth. They stroked the arabidopsis with soft paintbrushes, and then analyzed the plants' genetic responses. Within thirty minutes of being touched, 10 percent of the plant's genome was altered. Clearly, the plant was reorganizing its priorities to deal with the disturbance, and rerouting energy away from the hard work of getting taller. Touched multiple times, arabidopsis cut its upward growth rate by as much as 30 percent.

questions.passage: The genomics revolution made it possible to see just how (A)[impactful / negligible] touch is to plants on a deeper level. Peering at the genes of Arabidopsis thaliana, a weedy plant in the mustard family and the lab rat of the plant biology world, researchers saw that touch quietly triggered such a dramatic response in their hormones and gene expression that it could substantially (B)[inhibit / promote] their growth. They stroked the arabidopsis with soft paintbrushes, and then analyzed the plants' genetic responses. Within thirty minutes of being touched, 10 percent of the plant's genome was (C)[altered / preserved]. Clearly, the plant was reorganizing its priorities to deal with the disturbance, and rerouting energy away from the hard work of getting taller. Touched multiple times, arabidopsis cut its upward growth rate by as much as 30 percent.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① impactful(영향력 있는) + inhibit(억제하다) + altered(변형된) ← 정답
❌ ② negligible(무시할 만한) — 접촉이 식물에 큰 영향을 준다는 맥락에 부적절
❌ ③ promote(촉진하다) — 성장을 억제한다는 맥락에 반대, preserved(보존된) — 게놈이 변형되었으므로 부적절
❌ ④ negligible + promote + preserved — 3개 모두 원문과 반대

questions.passage: The genomics revolution made it possible to see just how impactful touch is to plants on a deeper level. Peering at the genes of Arabidopsis thaliana, a weedy plant in the mustard family and the lab rat of the plant biology world, researchers saw that touch quietly (A)[triggered / prevented] such a dramatic response in their hormones and gene expression that it could (B)[substantially / marginally] inhibit their growth. They stroked the arabidopsis with soft paintbrushes, and then analyzed the plants' genetic responses. Within thirty minutes of being touched, 10 percent of the plant's genome was altered. Clearly, the plant was reorganizing its priorities to deal with the disturbance, and (C)[rerouting / directing] energy away from the hard work of getting taller. Touched multiple times, arabidopsis cut its upward growth rate by as much as 30 percent.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① prevented(막았다) — 접촉이 반응을 유발(triggered)했으므로 부적절
❌ ② marginally(미미하게) — 상당히(substantially) 억제했으므로 부적절, directing(향하게 하다) — 에너지를 다른 곳으로 돌렸으므로 rerouting이 맞음
✅ ③ triggered(유발했다) + substantially(상당히) + rerouting(방향 전환) ← 정답
❌ ④ prevented + marginally + directing — 3개 모두 원문과 반대

questions.passage: The genomics revolution made it possible to see just how impactful touch is to plants on a deeper level. Peering at the genes of Arabidopsis thaliana, a weedy plant in the mustard family and the lab rat of the plant biology world, researchers saw that touch quietly triggered such a (A)[dramatic / subtle] response in their hormones and gene expression that it could substantially inhibit their growth. They stroked the arabidopsis with soft paintbrushes, and then analyzed the plants' genetic responses. Within thirty minutes of being touched, 10 percent of the plant's genome was altered. Clearly, the plant was reorganizing its priorities to deal with the (B)[disturbance / harmony], and rerouting energy away from the hard work of getting taller. Touched multiple times, arabidopsis (C)[cut / boosted] its upward growth rate by as much as 30 percent.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① subtle(미묘한) — 극적인(dramatic) 반응이므로 부적절
✅ ② dramatic(극적인) + disturbance(교란) + cut(줄였다) ← 정답
❌ ③ harmony(조화) — 접촉은 교란(disturbance)이므로 부적절, boosted(증가시켰다) — 성장률을 줄였으므로 cut이 맞음
❌ ④ subtle(미묘한) + harmony(조화) — 2개 오류

questions.passage: The genomics revolution made it possible to see just how ①<u>impactful</u> touch is to plants on a deeper level. Peering at the genes of Arabidopsis thaliana, a weedy plant in the mustard family and the lab rat of the plant biology world, researchers saw that touch quietly ②<u>triggered</u> such a dramatic response in their hormones and gene expression that it could substantially ③<u>facilitate</u> their growth. They stroked the arabidopsis with soft paintbrushes, and then analyzed the plants' genetic responses. Within thirty minutes of being touched, 10 percent of the plant's genome was ④<u>altered</u>. Clearly, the plant was reorganizing its priorities to deal with the disturbance, and rerouting energy away from the hard work of getting taller. Touched multiple times, arabidopsis cut its upward growth rate by as much as 30 percent.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① impactful: 영향력 있는 — 적절
✅ ② triggered: 유발했다 — 적절
❌ ③ facilitate: 촉진하다 → inhibit(억제하다) ← 정답
✅ ④ altered: 변형된 — 적절

questions.passage: The genomics revolution made it possible to see just how impactful touch is to plants on a deeper level. They stroked the arabidopsis with soft paintbrushes, and then analyzed the plants' genetic responses. Within thirty minutes of being touched, 10 percent of the plant's genome was altered. Clearly, the plant was ①<u>abandoning</u> its ②<u>priorities</u> to deal with the ③<u>disturbance</u>, and rerouting energy away from the hard work of getting taller. det.analysis:
❌ ① abandoning: 포기하는 → reorganizing(재편성하는) ← 정답
✅ ② priorities: 우선순위 — 적절
✅ ③ disturbance: 교란 — 적절
✅ ④ upward: 위쪽의 — 적절

det.korean: ④ channeling → rerouting: 에너지를 다른 곳으로 돌리는(rerouting) 것
